title: 七夕・夏祭りのイラスト
subject_en: Tanabata and summer-festival items and cute animals in yukata, kawaii Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 笹飾り、花火、金魚、浴衣の動物、かき氷などを描いた素材12点です。七夕や夏祭りのお知らせに使えます。
items: a bamboo branch with blank paper strips and paper decorations
a cute goldfish in a bag of water
a watermelon slice and a whole watermelon
a round fan with a plain pattern
a cat in a blue yukata holding a fan
a rabbit in a pink yukata
a row of red paper lanterns
a star cluster and a crescent
